title: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Move-In Charges and Entry Requirements by Unit Class
content:
Every Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is opened in one of six unit classes, and each class carries its own one-time move-in charges, its own reservation hold and its own entry requirements. The figures below are the class terms in force for every class.

## Schedule of move-in terms

| Unit class | Administrative fee at move-in | Security deposit | Free reservation hold | Minimum age | Minimum contents coverage required to enter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $29.00 | $0.00 (none) | 7 calendar days | 18 | coverage on file |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $29.00 | $0.00 (none) | 7 calendar days | 18 | coverage on file |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $29.00 | $0.00 (none) | 7 calendar days | 18 | coverage on file |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $29.00 | $0.00 (none) | 7 calendar days | 18 | coverage on file |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $39.00 | $50.00 | 10 calendar days | 18 | coverage on file of at least $5,000 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $39.00 | $100.00 | 14 calendar days | 21 | coverage on file of at least $10,000 |

Terms common to all six classes:

- **Identity document presented at move-in:** a government-issued photo ID, in every class.
- **Term of the agreement:** month to month, in every class.
- **Rent due dates:** anniversary billing in every class, meaning rent falls due on the move-in day of each month.
- **Entry gate:** in every class the tenant must present a government photo ID and must have contents coverage on file at move-in; the Bluegate Premier Climate Suite and the Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault additionally require that coverage to be at least the figure shown in the last column.

## Definitions used in the schedule

- **Administrative fee** — a one-time fee charged at move-in, in US dollars.
- **Security deposit** — a refundable deposit collected at move-in, in US dollars; $0.00 means the class carries no deposit.
- **Free reservation hold** — the number of calendar days a free reservation holds the unit after the reservation date.

## Reading the schedule (illustrative examples)

- A tenant moving into a hypothetical Bluegate Interior Standard unit pays a $29.00 administrative fee at move-in and no security deposit.
- A tenant moving into a hypothetical Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault unit must be at least 21, pays a $39.00 administrative fee and a $100.00 security deposit, and must have at least $10,000 of contents coverage on file.
- A reservation on a Bluegate Premier Climate Suite unit holds that unit for 10 calendar days after the reservation date; on a Bluegate Drive-Up Standard unit, for 7.
